reviewedContracts.privatePacketAndSceneBinding: Prepare creates registered private packet/control/derived environment paths; bind preserves original packet bytes, token and all three actual upload-file MD5s. Explicit read-only verify-scene validates GetScene admission, without claiming Start/Stop RAM permissions. Live phase consumes the bound derived environment and the exclusive user-created SceneId, not the initial UNBOUND configuration. Every prior command and the formal freeze bind loadBackend, packet SHA and admission SHA.
reviewedContracts.fixedWindows: PTS platform lifecycle is fixed at 600 seconds. Warm offers for 10 seconds and stable offers for 60 or 180 seconds. The platform duration is not used as the throughput denominator.
reviewedContracts.factsAndDownstream: The existing Like helper still performs fresh RR hydration, warm-to-stable inactive normalization, SQL/Redis/unique outbox reconciliation, and the three IGNORED receipt groups. The existing observer and bounded pipeline grader remain required; terminal draining does not replace native-window backlog checks.
reviewedContracts.fullLatency: All-request and verified mutation P95/P99 derive from the complete raw authenticated client record stream, using exact full-sample R7 quantiles. PTS sampled logs, 15-second aggregate reports, per-engine percentile averages, warm samples and control requests do not fill missing native evidence.
reviewedContracts.remoteStop: Phase completion requires both matching platform terminal evidence and both registered engines proving stoppedOffering with zero in-flight work. Runner child convergence additionally requires every phase terminal remoteConverged=true and owned local process convergence. A Stop API acknowledgement alone does not unlock another phase or slot.
reviewedContracts.abnormalEvidence: Unknown start is never automatically retried. Phase exceptions first latch collector stop; incomplete sequences, counts, terminal coverage or native timing cannot become exact zero unknown or a capacity pass.
reviewedContracts.resources: Before cloud pressure, remote RSS is declared per independently allocated engine below 2 GiB; aggregate remote RSS is displayed. Local Python collector plus Node helper retain a separate combined 2 GiB guard. Fresh resource and valid CPU interval timestamps cannot be refreshed by register or duplicate ACK traffic. These are environment adaptations, not Go optimization gains.
reviewedContracts.network: Collector binds the declared RFC1918 ECS address on 8481 and authenticates all routes. API listening on 0.0.0.0:8281 is the intentional private-PTS access adaptation and depends on the documented security-group restriction to PTS private sources. Diagnostics remain 127.0.0.1:8381; MySQL/Redis/Kafka/Elasticsearch host bindings remain loopback. No cloud security group or public ingress has been created by this local preparation.
